name: 6902-achievement-events
about: ev-ach (no code) has three luma.json achievements on the game's events: stage_start named EggStarGalaxy, coin of 5 and coin of 9. The stage's start unlocks the first; the test's MR::incCoin(5) unlocks the second; the coin of 9 never comes. The events' callbacks only read (NebulaModCallback returns nothing): the coins counted are the 5 given
